svg.title: How Cellulosic Ethanol Is Made
svg.desc: Original schematic three-quarter biorefinery: harvested biomass enters a shredder and pretreatment vessel, then connected enzyme and fermentation vessels, a distillation column and distribution tankers. Two cutaway windows show cellulose chains becoming sugars and microbes converting sugars to ethanol. Counts, proportions and molecular symbols are illustrative and not to scale. Source: original Biotechnology lecture ODP slide 30.
